title: Serializable Isolation for Snapshot Databases
authors: Michael J. Cahill, Uwe Rohm, Alan D. Fekete
description: Proposes Serializable Snapshot Isolation (SSI), a concurrency control algorithm that detects and aborts dangerous pairs of consecutive rw-antidependency edges at runtime to prevent all snapshot isolation anomalies, achieving full serializability with throughput approaching that of ordinary snapshot isolation.
